tool_calls.text: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(rg --files src/main/java | sort); do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/Payment.java src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/PaymentDispatcher.java src/main/java/com/example/accounts/payment/PaymentController.java src/main/java/com/example/accounts/integration/{scheme/*.java,fraud/*.java,ledger/*.java,notify/*.java} src/main/java/com/example/accounts/closure/*.java src/main/java/com/example/accounts/customer/*.java src/main/java/com/example/accounts/cases/{SupportCase.java,SupportCaseRepository.java}; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '"'1,300p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "awk -F'|' '/"'^'"\\| F-[0-9]+/ {gsub(/ /,\"\","'$7); gsub(/ /,"",$8); gsub(/ /,"",$9); gsub(/ /,"",$10); expected=$7*$8*$9; if (expected != $10) print "RPN mismatch:", $2, expected, $10} END {print "Failure modes:", n+0}'"' docs/fmea.md; rg -n '"'^'"\\| F-' docs/fmea.md | wc -l; git diff --stat && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "awk -F'|' '/"'^'"\\| F-[0-9]+/ {s="'$8+0;o=$9+0;d=$10+0;r=$11+0; if (s*o*d != r) print "RPN mismatch:", $2, s*o*d, r; n++} END {print "Validated failure modes:", n}'"' docs/fmea.md; sed -n '1,28p' docs/fmea.md"
